Sandbox_TrueHordes_Enabled_tooltip: Turns the True Hordes simulation on or off for this world.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_DebugLogging_tooltip: Writes extra [TrueHordes] lines to console.txt. Leave off unless testing.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_BuildingZombiesSeeded: New games: every building's zombies exist from day one (held by the mod, able to leave buildings), instead of appearing when a room is first seen. Makes mods like Wake Them Up unnecessary.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_EdgeArrivalMonths: Months until newcomers arrive from the map edges
Sandbox_TrueHordes_EdgeArrivalMonths_too: Respawned zombies first appear in long-unseen areas; over this many months a growing share walks in from the map's edges instead. 0 = always from the edges.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_StragglerOneIn: Stragglers: 1 in N never join hordes
Sandbox_TrueHordes_StragglerOneIn_toolti: This share of zombies never joins or follows a horde and lingers in or near buildings, so a town is never completely safe. 75 = 1 in 75.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_HordeFormSize: Zombies needed to form a horde
Sandbox_TrueHordes_HordeFormSize_tooltip: A group moving together becomes a horde at this size. Zombies just standing close together never form one.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_HordeMinSize_tooltip: A horde that shrinks below this size breaks up into single wanderers.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_FollowChance_tooltip: Chance per in-game hour that a wandering zombie that sees another zombie walking falls in behind it. Chains of followers grow into hordes.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_OffRoadChance_tooltip: How often a zombie or horde walking a road or trail turns off it into open ground, fields or woods. Lower keeps more of them on roads.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_BreakAwayChance_toolt: Chance for each horde member to get left behind when the horde squeezes through an alley or between buildings.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_TrailChance_tooltip: How often a zombie or horde walking a road turns onto a trail it passes.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_MoanResponseChance: Chance to notice a horde's moaning
Sandbox_TrueHordes_MoanResponseChance_to: Chance per in-game hour that a zombie who can hear a horde turns towards it. Higher makes hordes gather a city faster.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_JoinChance: Chance to join a horde in sight
Sandbox_TrueHordes_JoinChance_tooltip: Chance per in-game hour that a zombie who sees a horde joins it. Higher makes cities gather into hordes faster.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_BuildingStragglerOneI: Building stragglers: 1 in N stay inside
The zombies in a building wait together until a sound sets them loose. This share never leaves with them, so an emptied building may still hold one. 10 = 1 in 10.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_BumpFollowChance: Chance to follow a zombie it bumps into (at peak)
Sandbox_TrueHordes_BumpFollowChance_tool: When a walking zombie bumps into another, the chance it falls in behind it, reached on the population peak day. It ramps up: none on day 1, 1-2 percent on day 2, a quarter of it by day 7, half by day 14. Chains of 10 become hordes, so higher makes hordes form faster.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_SoundEdgeChance: Chance to hear a sound at the edge of its reach
Sandbox_TrueHordes_SoundEdgeChance_toolt: A lone zombie right at the edge of a sound's circle hears it with this chance; closer in it rises along the sound's fading energy to certain. Hordes hear less: their own moaning drowns sounds out.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_SoundCertainShare: Share of a sound's reach where every zombie hears it
Sandbox_TrueHordes_SoundCertainShare_too: Inside this share of a sound's circle (0.25 = the inner quarter) every lone zombie hears it; beyond, the chance fades with the sound's energy down to the edge chance.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_TravellerShare: Share of lone zombies that travel
Sandbox_TrueHordes_TravellerShare_toolti: Most lone zombies mill about their neighbourhood (about 150 tiles); this share are travellers that walk the roads between towns and ignore the lockdown. Hordes make the real crossings.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_LockdownDays: Day a 500-zombie town horde runs out of food
Sandbox_TrueHordes_LockdownDays_tooltip: Town hordes roam only their town until they run out of food, then leave along the roads. A horde of 500 leaves around this day; bigger hordes sooner, smaller ones later (each varies by 20 percent). 0 = no lockdown.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_MetaEvents_tooltip: True Hordes runs far meta events instead of vanilla: gunshots, screams and dog barks 300-1000 tiles away, every 1-3 days in the first month and getting rarer until about monthly after a year. Zombies hear them like any other sound. Owls and wolves stay as in vanilla.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_FarEventFrequency_too: Multiplies how often far meta events happen (2 = twice as often).
Sandbox_TrueHordes_NearEvents_tooltip: Rare events 50-100 tiles from you: a gunshot from a survivor (every 1-3 days in month 1, then a 10 percent chance per 31 days) and a real car alarm going off (every 2-3 days in month 1, then a 10 percent chance per 20 days, never after a year).
Sandbox_TrueHordes_NearGunshotFrequency_: Multiplies how often near gunshots happen (in month 1 the gaps shrink; later the chance per 31 days grows).
Sandbox_TrueHordes_CarAlarmFrequency_too: Multiplies how often a near car alarm goes off.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_CarAlarmBatteryHours_: In-game hours a full battery keeps a car alarm the mod set off sounding. It keeps going while the car is unloaded. Sit in the driver seat to stop it.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_WeatherHearing_toolti: Rain and storms muffle every sound zombies hear, and zombies inside a storm ignore thunder while zombies outside it are drawn to it. With True Weathers - Gameplay this follows its regional weather.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_WeatherMuffleDb_toolt: How much quieter every sound is in the heaviest rain. 6 dB halves how far a sound draws zombies.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_LightLure_tooltip: After the power grid shuts off, lit lights draw zombies at night: each zombie and each horde rolls once per light whether to go to it.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_BuildingLightLureChan: Chance (0 to 1) a zombie or horde goes to a lit building, floodlight or lamp.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_StreetlightLureChance: Chance (0 to 1) a zombie or horde goes to a lit streetlight. One that goes stays under it until morning.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_FlashlightLureChance_: Chance (0 to 1) a zombie your flashlight beam touches comes to you.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_LightReach_tooltip: How far away zombies notice a lit building, floodlight or lamp.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_StreetlightReach_tool: How far away zombies notice a lit streetlight.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_ChaseHours_tooltip: In-game hours a zombie that lost you keeps going: to where it last saw you, then on the way you were heading. If more than half of a horde saw you, the rest follow. 0 turns it off.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_PilotOrdersPerTick_to: Most path orders given to real zombies each tick. Lower is cheaper; higher keeps big crowds moving more smoothly.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_CrowdBreakIn_tooltip: Doors, windows, barricades and player-built walls break faster the more zombies are at them: a lone zombie takes hours, a huge horde minutes.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_FarSight_tooltip: Zombies beyond the loaded area are drawn as dark outlines where they walk, so hordes can be seen coming before they arrive.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_FarSightTiles_tooltip: How far from you the outlines are drawn.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_EdgeHordes_tooltip: Zombies respawning at the map's edge arrive together as a horde from the next county, bigger the older the world is.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_OffscreenShotsPerKill: Gunfire you hear far off (and A-Life fights) kills one held zombie near it per this many shots; they lie there as corpses when you arrive. 0: shooting off screen kills nobody.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_HordeTrample_tooltip: Where a horde of 20 or more walked off screen, crops are trampled; 50 or more knock down low fences, 150 or more tall wire ones.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_DoorSwingChance_toolt: Chance an open door swings shut behind a zombie walking in from outside, shutting it in. Up to three times as likely in strong wind. 0 turns it off.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_RainWashesBlood_toolt: Blood on open ground fades in the rain, most of it after a day of steady rain. Areas you are away from are washed by the rain that fell meanwhile.
